currentCount.description_en: The number of entries on the current page

data.description_en: The rule data returned based on the pagination settings for the current query conditions
data.description_zh: 当前查询条件下按照分页配置返回的规则数据

destLogstore.description_en: The destination Logstore for centralized delivery
destLogstore.description_zh: 中心化转投目的日志库

destProject.description_en: The destination project for centralized delivery

destRegion.description_en: The destination region for centralized delivery

destTTL.description_en: The data retention period in days for the centralized delivery destination
destTTL.description_zh: 中心化转投目的存储天数

centralizeEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether centralized delivery is enabled

dataConfig.description_en: The data configuration. This parameter is supported only when the log type is a global log type, such as when productCode is set to sls. Otherwise, this parameter is empty
dataConfig.description_zh: 当且仅当日志类型为全局日志类型时支持配置，例如productCode为sls时的场景。否则为空

dataProject.description_en: The data project. This parameter takes effect only when the log type is a global log type, such as when productCode is set to sls. If this parameter is empty, logs are collected to the default dedicated project of the account in the specified dataRegion
dataProject.description_zh: 当且仅当日志类型为全局日志类型时有效，例如productCode为sls时的场景，如果为空，表示日志被采集到该账号在特定dataRegion下的默认专属的Project中

dataRegion.description_en: The data region. This parameter is supported only when the log type is a global log type, such as when productCode is set to sls. This parameter specifies the region to which global logs are collected during initial configuration
dataRegion.description_zh: 当且仅当日志类型为全局日志类型时支持的配置，例如productCode为sls时的场景，表示首次配置时全局日志将被采集到对应地域

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is enabled

internalPolicy.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is a built-in policy. Built-in rules cannot be modified or deleted
internalPolicy.description_zh: 是否是内置规则策略，内置规则不允许修改、删除

regions.description_en: The list of regions to which the instances belong

policyUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the account to which the rule belongs. If the rule is created by a resource directory administrator or a delegated administrator of the resource directory, this parameter is set to the Alibaba Cloud account ID of that administrator
policyUid.description_zh: 规则所属的账号阿里云账号Uid，如果该规则由资源目录管理员或者资源目录委派管理员创建，则为其阿里云账号Uid

resourceDirectory.description_en: The resource directory configuration. This parameter is empty if no configuration exists
resourceDirectory.description_zh: 资源目录配置, 如有配置，否则为空

accountGroupType.description_en: The account group type in the resource directory. Valid values: all and custom
accountGroupType.description_zh: 在该资源目录下，全选模式all或自定义模式custom

members.description_en: The list of member accounts when the resource directory configuration is set to custom mode
members.description_zh: 当资源目录配置为custom模式时，对应的成员账号列表

statistics.description_en: The statistics returned for the current query conditions
statistics.description_zh: 当前查询条件下返回的统计数据

items.description_en: The rule statistics grouped by productCode
